title: Figma variable <-> code token map
description: Records the correspondence between Figma variables and the DTCG tokens under packages/tokens/tokens/. CODE IS CANONICAL for token VALUES — this map does not carry them. A variable whose `code` is null is drift: Figma has a variable with no token behind it.

lastScanned.description: ISO date of the last read, or null if never scanned. Null is an honest state and is what this template ships with.

source.description: A key in manifest.json -> sources. Never a raw file key.

collections.description: Figma collection name -> what was found in it.

codeSource.description: The DTCG file under packages/tokens/tokens/ this collection maps to. Null means unmapped — every variable in it will report as drift.

variables.description: Keyed by the Figma variable name exactly as it appears in the file.

variableId.description: File-local and EPHEMERAL. Refreshable, never a join key.

variableKey.description: Publish-time stable key — the DURABLE join, once the file is published as a library.

code.description: Verified dotted DTCG path into the collection's codeSource, e.g. `space.3`. NULL = drift: a Figma variable with no code token. Do not invent a path to clear a null — the null is the finding.
